sections.content: Use es *importante* *que*, es *necesario* que and es *bueno* que with the subjunctive to evaluate cultural practices.

items.spanish: Es importante que respetemos las tradiciones.
items.english: It is important that we respect traditions.

items.spanish: Es bueno que conozcamos otras culturas.
items.english: It is good that we learn about other cultures.

items.spanish: Es necesario que comparemos las costumbres sin juzgarlas.
items.english: It is necessary that we compare customs without judging them.

sections.content: Notice that es *bueno* *que* works the same way as es *importante* *que* — any es + adjective + *que* construction that judges an action, rather than just reporting a fact, pulls the following verb into the subjunctive.
